#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""vaultctl - client for vaultd (localhost:31337). Reads the passphrase from config.ini."""
import configparser, socket

def get_key(vault_id):
    cfg = configparser.ConfigParser()
    cfg.read("config.ini")
    s = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", 31337))
    f = s.makefile("rw")
    f.readline()  # banner
    f.write(f"AUTH {cfg['vault']['passphrase']}\n"); f.flush()
    f.readline()
    # TODO(v3): key request changed, see server banner
    raise NotImplementedError

import base64
data=open('vault.bin','rb').read()
lines=data.split(b'\n')
print('header:', lines[0])
payload=lines[1].strip()
raw=base64.b64decode(payload)
x=raw[::-1]  # un-reverse
key=bytes.fromhex('2702f866c3acdf44')
out=bytes(b ^ key[i%len(key)] for i,b in enumerate(x))
print(out)
# also try non-reversed for completeness
out2=bytes(b ^ key[i%len(key)] for i,b in enumerate(raw))
print('alt:', out2)
"
